items.title: What Does eBay (EBAY) Face After Carl Icahn Demands A Board Overhaul?
items.summary: Carl Icahn launches activist campaign targeting eBay (NasdaqGS: EBAY), urging a spin off of PayPal and major board changes. Icahn alleges conflicts of interest on eBay's board and questions past related party transactions. The activist letter calls for a separation of PayPal from eBay and a broad governance overhaul to reshape oversight. items.title: Akamai beats quarterly estimates on cloud infrastructure demand
items.summary: Akamai Technologies beat analysts' estimates for the second ‌quarter on Thursday, supported ‌by steady demand across its security and ​cloud infrastructure services portfolios, sending its shares up 10.5% in extended trading. The company recorded cloud infrastructure services ‌revenue of $99 million, ⁠up 39% over the year earlier.
